name: Semiconductor Support Services, Co
old_description: Our mission is to partner with our customers and enable them to sustain and improve their operations, using our high quality services and products.
about:
Semiconductor Support Services, Co. (SSSco) was established in 2001 and is headquartered in Austin, Texas. The company operates as a privately held business serving the semiconductor manufacturing sector.

SSSco provides a range of services and products focused on wafer fabrication equipment. Its offerings include equipment repairs, upgrades, and retrofits, along with on-site support and training. The company maintains a large inventory of OEM and equivalent spare parts for systems from Applied Materials (AMAT), MKS, SMC, Lam Research, and Tokyo Electron (TEL). SSSco also develops and sells its own Penulator™ product family, which includes remote, data, video, and single-board computer (SBC) modules designed to improve equipment efficiency and address obsolescence. A repair center and upgrade center support these activities.

The company serves semiconductor fabs and equipment owners who operate AMAT Endura, Centura, and Producer platforms, among others. Specific project examples cited by SSSco include HP/HP+ robot driver upgrades, EPI and Poly SCR driver upgrades, and AMAT MUX PCB repairs. Customers range from chipmakers seeking productivity gains to those needing obsolescence solutions for legacy tools.

SSSco states its mission is to partner with customers to sustain and improve their operations through high-quality services and products. The company emphasizes rapid response with the tagline "When it has to be right…now," reflecting a focus on minimizing downtime for critical fab equipment.
